tiers.description: Exactly one charge per classic tier and optionally one for CONSOLIDATED (free when omitted); a missing classic tier is 422 incomplete-charge-schedule, a repeated or unknown tier 422 validation-failed.

tier.description: The delivery-promise service tier. CONSOLIDATED (opt-in) is a known tier whose delivery charge is zero unless the current schedule declares a row for it (ADR 0010).
tier.title: Tier
